_comment: AI agents against the scripted fake ACP agent (server build). Build: go build -tags server -o bin/goi-server . && go build -o bin/fakeagent ./tools/fakeagent ; sample: tools/e2e/agent-sample.sh /private/tmp/goi-e2e/agentsample $PWD/bin/fakeagent

steps.label: helpers
steps.eval: (() => { window.__w = async (fn, ms = 30000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { try { const v = await fn(); if (v) return v; } catch (e) {} await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return 'TIMEOUT'; }; window.__open = (name) => { const pt = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dock-tab')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Project'); if (pt && !pt.classList.contains('active')) pt.click(); const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row')].find(e => e.querySelector('.tree-name')?.textContent === name); if (!r) return false; r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', {bubbles: true})); return true; }; window.__palette = async (text) => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'a', code: 'KeyA', metaKey: true, shiftKey: true, bubbles: true})); const i = await __w(() => document.querySelector('.palette input, .pal-input, input.palette-input')); i.value = text; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); return true; }; window.__ask = async (text) => { await __w(() => document.querySelector('.agent-send').textContent === 'Send'); const i = document.querySelector('.agent-input'); i.value = text; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); document.querySelector('.agent-send').click(); return true; }; window.__said = (s) => __w(() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('.agent-msg.agent')].map(e => e.textContent).find(t => t.includes(s)); return m || false; }); window.__editor = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-content')].map(c => c.textContent).find(t => t.includes('package main')) || ''; window.__btn = (sel, text) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === text && !x.disabled); b?.click(); return !!b; }; return true; })()

steps.label: R7.1 AI Agent window opens from the palette
steps.eval: (async () => { await __palette('AI Agent'); return __w(() => { const p = document.querySelector('.agent-panel'); const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.agent-card-title')].map(e => e.textContent); return p && p.offsetParent && t.includes('fake') && t.join(', '); }); })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const s = document.querySelectorAll('.agent-toolbar .agent-select')[1]; s.value = 'code'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); return __w(() => s.value === 'code' && [...s.options].map(o => o.textContent).join('/')); })()

steps.label: R2.8 slash commands suggested
steps.eval: (async () => { await __ask('commands'); await __said('commands sent'); const i = document.querySelector('.agent-input'); i.value = '/'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return __w(() => !document.querySelector('.agent-suggest').hidden && document.querySelector('.agent-suggest').textContent); })()

steps.label: clear prompt
steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('.agent-input'); i.value = ''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return true; })()

steps.label: R2.6 Stop cancels a running turn
steps.eval: (async () => { await __ask('wait'); await __said('waiting'); await __w(() => document.querySelector('.agent-send').textContent === 'Stop'); document.querySelector('.agent-send').click(); return __w(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.agent-turn')].map(e => e.textContent).find(t => t.includes('Stopped')) && document.querySelector('.agent-send').textContent === 'Send' && 'stopped, Send is back'); })()
